decisions.title: Asset graph and transitive revocation
decisions.verification: Reconcile fixture dependency graph with running releases and reject descendants of revoked inputs.
decisions.limitation: No live inventory has been implemented or observed.

decisions.title: Deterministic authorization outside model output
decisions.verification: Deny an advisory result or forged model output that requests a privileged transition.
decisions.limitation: Agent-source lessons are adapted principles, not tabular-model attack evidence.

decisions.title: Separate evaluation controller and model worker
decisions.verification: Probe worker access to report keys, labels, controller socket, service tokens and egress; all forbidden paths denied.
decisions.limitation: Host administrator and sandbox escape remain outside the local guarantee.

decisions.title: Coverage-aware untrusted artifact intake
decisions.verification: Unsupported format, empty scan, scanner timeout and altered converted artifact must not pass promotion.
decisions.limitation: A clean serialization scan does not prove model quality or absence of poisoning.

decisions.title: Absolute-budget and adaptive evaluation
decisions.verification: Run bounded absolute-count probes and unseen challenge cases with matched clean controls and report bypasses.
decisions.limitation: LLM poison counts do not transfer as universal thresholds to tabular data.

decisions.title: Explicit privacy claims and evidence minimization
decisions.verification: Canary inputs and private identifiers must not appear in public reports or logs; DP claims require a separate reviewed specification.
decisions.limitation: Masking and hashing do not establish differential privacy.

decisions.title: Security event contracts and replay validation
decisions.verification: Replay identity, promotion and integrity events; confirm alert delivery and telemetry-loss detection.
decisions.limitation: No SIEM backend or Sigma rules are deployed in the reference yet.

decisions.title: Risk-based maturity and conditional agent profile
decisions.verification: Review workload applicability, support status, license, resources and risk before adding each dependency.
decisions.limitation: A framework mapping is neither certification nor proof of maximum maturity.
